बॉलीवुड की पसंदीदा जोड़ी कैटरीना कैफ और विक्की कौशल की पर्सनल लाइफ को लेकर आया है एक प्यारा अपडेट! ❤️

Vogue को दिए एक इंटरव्यू में कैटरीना ने पति विक्की कौशल की जमकर तारीफ करते हुए उन्हें अमेजिंग फादर बताया। कैटरीना ने खुलासा किया कि 14, 16 या 18 घंटे काम करने के बाद थकने के बावजूद विक्की अपने बेटे विहान और उनके साथ 100 प्रतिशत मौजूद रहते हैं।

हालांकि, एक्ट्रेस ने माना कि पैरेंट बनने के बाद से उनकी रोमांटिक डिनर डेट्स और मूवी नाइट्स थोड़ी पीछे छूट गई हैं। लेकिन विक्की उन्हें हमेशा याद दिलाते हैं कि हर चीज़ अपने वक्त पर फिर से ठीक हो जाएगी।

साल 2021 में शादी के बंधन में बंधे इस कपल ने साल 2025 में अपने बेटे का स्वागत किया था। हाल ही में London में अपने ब्रांड Kay Beauty के लॉन्च पर कैटरीना ने बॉडी-शेमिंग और ट्रोल्स को करारा जवाब देते हुए कहा कि सोशल मीडिया कमेंट्स से अपनी सेल्फ-वर्थ तय न होने दें। 🌟

क्या आपको भी लगता है कि विक्की कौशल बॉलीवुड के सबसे परफेक्ट हसबैंड और डैड हैं? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Katrina Kaif says Vicky Kaushal is 100% present with son Vihaan even after 18-hour workdays, reveals their romantic dinners have taken a backseat
ctx.summary: Katrina Kaif said parenthood and busy schedules have put romantic dates with Vicky Kaushal on hold for now.
ctx.text:
Vicky Kaushal and Katrina Kaif became parents last year. Although the couple have kept their personal lives away from the cameras, including keeping their son Vihaan Kaushal out of the public eye, they occasionally open up about their family life. In a recent interaction, Katrina showered praise on her husband, actor Vicky, and called him an “amazing” father.
Speaking to Vogue, Katrina lauded Vicky for being patient and a good listener, describing him as the perfect partner for someone like her, who tends to have a lot to say. She said, "Vicky is an incredible husband. He is wise beyond his years, has strong family values and a true sense of integrity. I would say Vicky is wise in practice, and I am wise in theory. One of the best things about him is that he always gives me space to be myself while being a great listener, and I can have a lot to say sometimes.”
Katrina also praised Vicky's ability to be fully present with her and their son despite his hectic work schedule. However, she admitted that balancing their high-profile careers and parenthood has meant fewer romantic dinners and movie nights.
“As a father, he’s been amazing. He has this incredible superpower to be 100 per cent present in the moment with Vihaan and me, even when he is tired and has been working 14, 16 or 18 hours a day. Our romantic dinners and movie nights have taken a backseat for now, but Vicky keeps reminding me that everything will find its own time again,” she said.
Since becoming a mother, Katrina has largely stayed away from the spotlight. However, the actor was recently spotted at Ganesh Chaturthi celebrations and out and about in Mumbai. She has also faced body-shaming comments following the birth of her son.
Recently, at an event in London, Katrina responded to online trolls and spoke about the importance of not letting social media criticism affect one's self-worth. She said, “I think we really need to be careful in letting the narrative on social media affect our self-worth. If we start trying to cater to all of them, I think that really hampers your ability to make choices for yourself. Personally, if every time I face critique or comments, I let that dictate my actions, I think I would have been paralysed with fear and unable to move ahead in my life.”
Katrina has been selective about her film roles since marrying Vicky in 2021. The couple welcomed their son in 2025. In addition to her acting career, Katrina has focused on expanding her makeup brand, Kay Beauty, which recently launched in the UK. On the film front, she was last seen in the 2024 film Merry Christmas, directed by Sriram Raghavan and co-starring Vijay Sethupathi.

A self-confessed cinephile who breathes Hindi cinema, Vibha can often be found sacrificing sleep after binge-watching films and web series. Though she holds a Commerce degree, she discovered her true calling in journalism after enrolling at the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC). She began her career covering Delhi's cultural scene, food, nightlife, concerts, and city life at The Times of India, before moving into full-time entertainment journalism with India Today.

At India Today, Vibha interviewed some of the biggest names in Bollywood and television while carving a niche for herself through film reviews, opinion pieces, nostalgic features, celebrity interviews, and trend-driven stories. She later brought her storytelling and editorial expertise to The Indian Express, where she continued to deepen her understanding of cinema through long-form entertainment explainers, retrospectives and feature writing.
